sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Bookings"."customer_id" AS e, "Customers"."gender_mf" AS g, SUM("Bookings"."count_hired") AS m1 FROM "Bookings" JOIN "Customers" ON "Customers"."customer_id" = "Bookings"."customer_id"  GROUP BY "Bookings"."customer_id", "Customers"."gender_mf"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: total of number of items hired per Customers within Customers.gender_mf (additive)
share of the all total of total of number of items hired (all level)
rank within the group by total of number of items hired, keep the top 3
